name_ar: كشف موضوع بحركة كاميرا بطيئة سينمائية
purpose: Generate a 5–8 second cinematic video clip with a slow-dolly push-in revealing a hero subject (person, product, location). Premium-feel pacing, shallow depth of field, warm grade. Designed for Pipeline B brands with signature camera-move locks.

hero_subject_description.description: Detailed description of the hero subject (person, product, scene)

setting_description.description: Where this happens — must align with brand cultural spec architecture

first_frame_description.description: What the first frame shows (will be generated as keyframe before video)

talent_reference_uri.description: If brand has locked talent, reference image for character consistency

prompt_template: Cinematic slow-dolly push-in, 6 seconds, {duration_seconds}s pacing register. First frame: {first_frame_description}. Last frame: {last_frame_description}. Hero subject: {hero_subject_description}. Setting: {setting_description}. Cinematography: {lighting_style_from_fingerprint}, {focal_length_from_fingerprint}, {depth_of_field_from_fingerprint}, eye-level camera, frontal angle. Color grade: {color_grade_from_fingerprint}. Motion: slow controlled dolly push-in, no handheld jitter. Subject motion: minimal, naturalistic. {cultural_constraints_injection}. No music. No text overlay (separate chain).
anti_patterns: Do not pair with fast-pacing register — defeats the purpose
Avoid for time-sensitive announcement content (use TF03 or TF16)
Do not use without locked first/last frame keyframes
Avoid when the brief calls for kinetic or energetic feel (use TF22_05 instead)
notes: This is the signature chain for Pipeline B Growth and Enterprise brands with a slow-dolly signature move. Always validate first/last frames against the brand's locked frame categories before video generation kicks off.
